appearance_facts.fact: Title text reads 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.
A single solid blue line connects four data points, one per quarter, rising continuously from left to right.
The Q1 point sits just above the 1,000 gridline; Q2 is near 1,300; Q3 is near 1,500; Q4 is near 1,850, each higher than the prior quarter.
Vertical axis is labeled 'Revenue' with ticks 0 to 2,000 in steps of 200; horizontal axis is labeled 'Quarter' with Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.

printed_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.
Axis label 'Quarter'; category labels Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 in left-to-right order.
One blue line series with no legend; values increase monotonically across Q1 through Q4.

public_definitions: Task scope: 'Review the Company C revenue dashboard for the Q1-Q4 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the revenue trend.'
Option condition: select one of 'Route to revenue growth response', 'Route to revenue stability response', or 'Route to revenue decline response'.
Evidence source: 'Use the Company C revenue dashboard as the evidence source for the revenue trend routing decision.'
uncertain: No explicit numeric data labels are printed at the four points; the per-quarter values are read from gridline position and are approximate.
The title word 'Stable' conflicts with the visibly rising line; the routing decision depends on interpreting the trend direction, which is not numerically annotated.
